references.text: Jesus confirms His divine identity with the expression "I am" (egō eimi), which directly answers the question of who He is in verse 25 and connects to eternal existence.
God requires that the people know He is "He who is" (egō eimi) and the only God, a theme Jesus addresses when asked about His identity.
Here God uses the expression "I am the first and the last" and "I am," which resonates with Jesus' claim to be "in the beginning" and His divine self-revelation.
